text:
Ravi: Taco truck parked outside Tuesday lunchtime? I can ask vendor if they can swing by around 12:15. :taco:
Theo: omg yes. company-sponsored? or split?
Ravi: thinking split but we can pitch $50 from team social for toppings/salsa and napkins.
Priya: i'll chip in. can someone confirm vegan options?
Dana: vendor says they can do a tofu al pastor and corn tortillas. no cross-contam guaranteed but they'll try.
Eli: also, micro-trivia after lunch? 5 questions, 10 mins, prizes = leftover tacos? :laughing:
Theo: prize = bragging rights + one mystery hot sauce bottle. i'm in. :raised_hands:
Priya: count me for trivia. two quick asks: 1) any nut allergies? 2) table near elevators?
Ravi: no nut allergies reported so far. table near elevator sounds good for access.
Dana: i can bring a collapsible sign that says "Tacos + Trivia here".
lunchbot: Poll posted: "Taco truck + trivia Tuesday 12:15 - Join?" React with :thumbsup: to come, :thumbsdown: to skip. I'll tally RSVP at 11:30.
Eli: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Theo: :thumbsup:
Ravi: :thumbsup:
Dana: :thumbsup:
Ravi: logistics: bring cash or card? vendor accepts cards but $1 fee per transaction. maybe pool cash to avoid fees.
Theo: i'll bring $20 cash. how much should we pool? estimate 10 ppl * ~$9 = $90. so $100 with buffer?
Priya: i'll Venmo $15 to @Ravi now.
Ravi: thanks! i'll collect and hand to vendor.
Eli: trivia host volunteer? i'll make 5 quick questions (mix of geography + pop culture).
Dana: i'll bring a small speaker and a bell for correct answers.
Ravi: perfect. backup plan if it rains: move to 3rd-floor lounge, vendor can still serve at the loading dock.
Theo: note for folks working remote - feel free to drop by for food pick-up at 12:40.
Priya: any objections to keeping it family-friendly? avoid spicy challenge.
Eli: agreed. no extreme spice. :hot_pepper:
Ravi: final call: vendor confirmed. see you Tuesday 12:15 outside main doors. i'll post a reminder Monday night.
lunchbot: Reminder set: "Taco truck + micro-trivia" Tuesday 11:45 1: I'll DM the RSVP list at 11:30.
